title: Hinomori Shizuku — Completion Report!〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Okay, see you tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'm glad Miku and the others liked our outfits so much.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Me too. It was nice to hear them say they were cute since our thoughts and feelings are essentially a part of them.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, also... Would it be alright if I told Mizuki that our outfits are all done?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: You want to talk about what materials to use for your stage outfits?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes. I'd like to take a look at as many options as I can and choose the ones that fit our needs best.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You mentioned before that you like doing collages, so I have a feeling you know quite a lot about these things.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Like you said, there's a lot. So many that I'd really rather have you look at images of some of them to get a better idea...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
But first... Here!
I brought all the flowery lace stuff I could find at home!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: They really come in all shapes and sizes. Fine doesn't even begin to describe how detailed some of these patterns are!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. It's like you're a professional having all this lace in your possession.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Haha! Sometimes I really wonder if I could actually open my own store.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I was able to get a clear idea of our outfits because Mizuki was nice enough to show me all these different materials and such.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That's why I'd like to give my thanks while presenting the finished product...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, sounds good!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It's been a while since I last saw Mizuki, so why don't we three meet up somewhere?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Really?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Okay, I'll ask Mizuki to see when would be a good time♪
The next day
Cafe

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, Mizuki, welcome!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hey, thanks for having me♪

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
This isn't your house, Shizuku.
Also, Mizuki, you don't need to play along.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Haha! Sorry, I couldn't help it...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: So, your outfits are all done?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes. I wanted to show them to you since you were such a tremendous help.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Thanks! I've been wondering how they turned out, so it's kinda been on my mind for a while now♪

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. Alright, why don't we do our big reveal? Here's a picture of our outfits.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Whoa...! Th-They look amazing!
You guys are gonna look so awesome on stage!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I mean, look at the frills on the hem and how fluffy they made the skirt! It's gonna look so gorgeous as it floats each time you move...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hang on! And the accessories on the bust! How can anyone sew on decorations with this much detail?!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: At minimum, these outfits count as being divine!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That's the thing! I couldn't believe it when I saw them for the first time either.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We'll need to thank everyone for putting so much thought into making them.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, definitely!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Your own feelings and your fans' love for their favorite idols are a huge part of these, huh, Shizuku?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: This is so exciting! These are movingly good! I can't wait to see all of you wearing these!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. We can't wait to do a show while wearing these too.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Whoa! Does that mean your second real-life show's already in the works?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yes. We've been thinking about taking this opportunity to sing a brand-new song.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: A new song?!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hold up. Does that mean...?
A MORE MORE JUMP! original?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That's right. We even got a request from someone saying that they want to write one for us.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: And we'll be meeting with them soon to discuss it.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Cool! I'm glad things are going so smoothly♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
And that's so great...
You already found someone to write it for you.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Hmm... Let's say Kanade knew how to compose music for idols. Would this have been our chance to collaborate with them?)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Anyway, I'm sure you have high expectations for this person you're meeting.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I really hope they're nice and able to create music that brings out all of your unique qualities to the forefront! That'd be the best!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, I'd like that as well.
I'm really looking forward to meeting them.
